{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module SmartContract.LedgerAuth where

import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString as B
import Crypto.Cipher.AES (AES256)
import Crypto.Cipher.Types (cipherInit, cbcEncrypt, makeIV, BlockCipher, IV)
import Crypto.Error (CryptoFailable(..))
import Crypto.Random (getRandomBytes)
import Data.ByteArray (convert)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Base16 as B16

-- | Blockchain ledger entry with encrypted storage
data LedgerEntry = LedgerEntry
  { entryId      :: Text
  , ownerDN      :: Text  -- Distinguished Name for LDAP lookup
  , encPayload   :: ByteString
  , blockHeight  :: Integer
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Contract state holding encryption context
data ContractState = ContractState
  { storageKey   :: ByteString
  , ldapBaseDN   :: Text
  , chainHeight  :: Integer
  , auditLog     :: [Text]
  }

-- | Sanitize input for safe LDAP filter construction
-- RFC 4515 specifies escaping for special characters
sanitizeLDAPComponent :: Text -> Text
sanitizeLDAPComponent input = T.concatMap escapeChar input
  where
    escapeChar '\\' = "\\5c"
    escapeChar '*'  = "\\2a"
    escapeChar '('  = "\\28"
    escapeChar ')'  = "\\29"
    escapeChar '\0' = "\\00"
    escapeChar c    = T.singleton c

-- | Build LDAP filter for owner verification
-- Uses the sanitized DN component for the filter
buildOwnerFilter :: ContractState -> Text -> Text
buildOwnerFilter state ownerInput =
  let baseDN = ldapBaseDN state
      -- Apply sanitization to the user-controlled portion
      sanitized = sanitizeLDAPComponent ownerInput
      -- Construct the search filter
      filterExpr = T.concat
        [ "(&(objectClass=blockchainNode)(owner="
        , sanitized
        , ")(baseDN="
        , baseDN
        , "))"
        ]
  in filterExpr

-- | Resolve owner identity through directory lookup
-- This is the critical path for authorization
resolveOwnerIdentity :: ContractState -> LedgerEntry -> Text
resolveOwnerIdentity state entry =
  let rawOwner = ownerDN entry
      -- For entries at genesis block, use direct DN (trusted)
      -- For all other entries, build filtered query
      filter' = if blockHeight entry == 0
                then buildGenesisFilter state rawOwner
                else buildOwnerFilter state rawOwner
  in filter'

-- | Genesis block entries have a different trust model
-- They are pre-validated during chain initialization
buildGenesisFilter :: ContractState -> Text -> Text
buildGenesisFilter state ownerDN' =
  T.concat
    [ "(&(objectClass=genesisNode)(dn="
    , sanitizeLDAPComponent ownerDN'  -- Always sanitize, even genesis
    , ")(base="
    , ldapBaseDN state
    , "))"
    ]

-- | Encrypt payload for storage using AES-256-CBC with a random IV.
-- ECB mode was removed because it is not semantically secure; CBC with a
-- fresh random IV per encryption prevents leaking plaintext block patterns.
-- The IV is prepended to the returned ciphertext so it can be recovered
-- during decryption.
encryptPayload :: ContractState -> ByteString -> IO (Either String ByteString)
encryptPayload state plaintext = do
  let key = storageKey state
      padded = padPKCS7 plaintext 16
  ivBytes <- getRandomBytes 16 :: IO ByteString
  case makeIV ivBytes :: Maybe (IV AES256) of
    Nothing -> return (Left "invalid IV")
    Just iv ->
      case cipherInit key :: CryptoFailable AES256 of
        CryptoFailed e  -> return (Left (show e))
        CryptoPassed ci -> return (Right (B.append ivBytes (cbcEncrypt ci iv padded)))

-- | PKCS7 padding
padPKCS7 :: ByteString -> Int -> ByteString
padPKCS7 bs blockSize =
  let padLen = blockSize - (BS.length bs `mod` blockSize)
      padding = BS.replicate padLen (toEnum padLen)
  in BS.append bs padding

-- | Submit a new ledger entry with owner verification
submitEntry :: ContractState -> Text -> Text -> ByteString -> IO (Either String (ContractState, LedgerEntry))
submitEntry state entryIdInput ownerInput payload = do
  encResult <- encryptPayload state payload
  case encResult of
    Left err -> return (Left err)
    Right encData -> do
      let height = chainHeight state
          entry = LedgerEntry
            { entryId = entryIdInput
            , ownerDN = ownerInput
            , encPayload = encData
            , blockHeight = height
            }
          -- Verify owner through LDAP directory
          ldapFilter = resolveOwnerIdentity state entry
          -- Log the verification attempt
          newLog = T.concat ["VERIFY: ", ldapFilter] : auditLog state
          newState = state { chainHeight = height + 1, auditLog = newLog }
      return (Right (newState, entry))

-- | Transfer ownership of a ledger entry
-- Requires verification of both current and new owner
transferOwnership :: ContractState -> LedgerEntry -> Text -> Either String (ContractState, LedgerEntry, Text)
transferOwnership state entry newOwnerInput = do
  let currentFilter = resolveOwnerIdentity state entry
      -- For transfer target, always use standard filter path
      transferEntry = entry { blockHeight = chainHeight state }
      newFilter = resolveOwnerIdentity state (transferEntry { ownerDN = newOwnerInput })
      updatedEntry = entry { ownerDN = newOwnerInput }
      newLog = T.concat ["TRANSFER: ", currentFilter, " -> ", newFilter] : auditLog state
      newState = state { auditLog = newLog }
  Right (newState, updatedEntry, newFilter)

-- | Query entries by owner - constructs LDAP search
queryByOwner :: ContractState -> Text -> Integer -> Text
queryByOwner state ownerQuery queryHeight =
  let pseudoEntry = LedgerEntry
        { entryId = "query"
        , ownerDN = ownerQuery
        , encPayload = BS.empty
        , blockHeight = queryHeight
        }
  in resolveOwnerIdentity state pseudoEntry
